title: Membership in an embedding preimage
statement: Let $m,n$ be natural numbers, let $e: br^{m}\to br^{n}$ be an injective map between the index sets $ br^{m}$ and $ br^{n}$, and let $A$ be a set of indices in $ br^{n}$. An index $i$ belongs to the preimage of $A$ under $e$ if and only if $e(i)$ belongs to $A$.
hypotheses_covered: Injective map from the $m$-element index set to the $n$-element index set
Finite set of indices in the $n$-element index set
caveat: The index sets are $	ext{Fin}(m)$ and $	ext{Fin}(n)$; their usual notation is awkward under the permitted LaTeX commands.
